definition: בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי proper name, of a location (literally well of the living One that seeth me ) ** לַחַי perhaps originally I. לְחִי jaw(-bone) ; on proper name, of a location compared with לחי , γνάφος , see ᵐ5 Judg 15:9 We Prol. 344 Nes AJSL xiii {1897} 176 . Gen 16:14 (where explanation, from story of Hagar) Gen 24:62 ; Gen 25:11 (all J ); perhaps name of ancient shrine or holy place, compare Sta ZAW ii. 347 & Di Gen 16:14 west of Kadesh, compare Jerome below Barad, Lag Onom. 101, 2nd ed. 135 , see Rowlands in Williams Holy City, 489 Trumbull Kadesh-Barnea 64 .
